description: Committed record of the last real-runtime comparison validation for each Linux-executable comparison-runtime track. The risk ledger (scripts/buildRiskLedger.js, VHS-REQ-601) reads this file and surfaces any track whose lastValidatedVersion is not the current build version as a selectable runtime-fidelity re-validation risk. Windows host-native and windows-container tracks are intentionally NOT listed as Linux-executable tracks: they are covered by the parked platform-proof awareness list (issue #1316) because they are not executable on a Linux host. EXCEPTION: a track marked releaseGating:true (linuxExecutable:false) is the mandatory local Vagrant release attestation (VHS-REQ-666) read by scripts/checkReleaseReadiness.js --require-release-attestation; the marketplace-release workflow fails closed unless its lastValidatedVersion equals the release version. Update a track's lastValidatedVersion/lastValidatedCommit/evidence after re-running its driver against a new build (use scripts/recordRuntimeValidation.js).
